entradas.text: The locomotive assistant flipped a few switches, and the train began pulling out of the central station. Lucian waved at the press photographers as I "drove".
It was a great victory for my administration.
The railway officially opened to the public right after we left, and thousands began using it.
We walked towards the line where the first electric train was waiting.
I cut the ribbon, triggering cheers from the crowd.
entradas.menu: Cut the ribbon.

entradas.text: “Congratulations to all. Hopefully this success will lead to many more.”
“It's a good moment indeed. We have helped so many in the countryside.”
“The train is prepared, sir.”
A red ribbon was hanging by the door of the train.
“Sounds fantastic. The President arriving to Lachaven in the driver's seat would make the headlines for sure.”
It was finally happening. Tomorrow would be the grand opening ceremony of the L-1 High-speed rail.
Symon and Gus, who had heavily assisted in the project, had come to discuss the ceremony plans with Lucian and myself.
“I don't support anything beyond the opening ceremony. The railway's completion speaks for itself.”
“Thank you, Mr. President.”
“I see your point. But involving the President further could be beneficial for the administration.”
I entered the cab and took a seat with the assistant beside me. The crowd was trying to catch a glimpse of me through the window.
entradas.menu: Get in the train.

entradas.text: “Alright then. We have a lot of work to do. See you tomorrow morning.”
“It's been a long time since the last successful infrastructure project. From a public relations point of view, we can certainly capitalize on the occasion.”
“I'd like Gus with me.”
entradas.menu: “I'd like Gus with me.”

entradas.text: “I will drive the train on my own.”
entradas.menu: “I will drive the train on my own.”

entradas.text: Symon walked up beside me.
“I'm honored. It will be great to arrive in Lachaven with the President of Sordland.”
“I want to have Symon in the cab.”
entradas.menu: “I want to have Symon in the cab.”

entradas.text: “Who do you want to travel with in the cab, Mr. President?”
“Lucian, I want you to ride with me.”
entradas.menu: “Lucian, I want you to ride with me.”

entradas.text: “This isn't necessary, but I won't refuse. We can talk about future economic projects.”
“Thank you, Mr. President. It will be a good journey. We can talk about the election campaign preparations.”
“I agree. Get me on that train."
entradas.menu: “I agree. Get me on that train."

entradas.text: “I'd prefer we just do the opening ceremony. No need for senseless spectacle.”
entradas.menu: “I'd prefer we just do the opening ceremony. No need for senseless spectacle.”

entradas.text: “Sure. We will be in the other carriages. See you in Lachaven.”
“Thanks to this railway, thousands of new jobs have been and will continue to be created."
entradas.menu: “Thanks to this railway, thousands of new jobs have been and will continue to be created."

entradas.text: Gus sauntered over to the podium and leaned into the microphone.
The locomotive assistant flipped a few switches, and the train began pulling out of the central station. Symon smiled awkwardly at the press photographers as I "drove".
The locomotive assistant flipped a few switches, and the train began pulling out of the central station. Gus gave a thumbs-up to the press photographers as I "drove".
"Thanks to this railway, travel between Holsord and Lachaven is now twice as fast and endlessly more comfortable."
entradas.menu: "Thanks to this railway, travel between Holsord and Lachaven is now twice as fast and endlessly more comfortable."

entradas.text: The locomotive assistant flipped a few switches, and the train began pulling out of the central station. I waved at the press photographers as I "drove".
“Of course. We'll hold the ceremony and open the upgraded railway to the public immediately after.”
“Very well.”
“Ensuring the success of this project wasn't just one of my presidential goals -- it was my personal priority."
entradas.menu: “Ensuring the success of this project wasn't just one of my presidential goals -- it was my personal priority."

entradas.text: I walked up to the podium to address the crowd. The press was taking dozens of pictures.
entradas.menu: Walk to the podium.

entradas.text: Lucian's voice echoed in the central station. Thousands of Sordland and USP flags began to wave as the loud cheers intensified.
The new train was in pristine condition. Its electric engine provided the smoothest ride I'd ever had.
“This railway project is a perfect example of how we can bring prosperity to the under-developed areas between our major cities.”
“See you at the ceremony.”
entradas.menu: “See you at the ceremony.”

entradas.text: “The people will be satisfied with their improved transportation service anyway.”
“Additionally, a large crowd has been invited to the ceremony and will be watching the opening speech.”
After an uneventful four hours on board, we were welcomed by a throng of citizens at Lachaven station.
Lucian took my place on the stage to close the ceremony.
“Once we cut that ribbon and the citizens of Holsord get on the train, I believe you'll agree we have succeeded."
I gave the green light to Lucian, and the opening address began.
entradas.menu: Signal for Lucian to begin the ceremony.

entradas.text: The next morning, a stage had been erected inside the central station.
“Brothers and sisters of Sordland!”
“Goodbye for now.”
entradas.menu: “Goodbye for now.”

entradas.text: “Thanks, Mr. President.”
We took our places onstage.
“It will be a good opportunity for exposure.”
entradas.menu: “It will be a good opportunity for exposure.”

entradas.text: “People of Sordland! Welcome to the opening ceremony of the L-1 High-speed railway.”
entradas.menu: “People of Sordland! Welcome to the opening ceremony of the L-1 High-speed railway.”

entradas.text: We all dispersed in order to prepare for the big day.
“We built this railway to create economic growth throughout the Greater Holsord and Gelsland regions."
entradas.menu: “We built this railway to create economic growth throughout the Greater Holsord and Gelsland regions."

entradas.text: “Without further ado, I invite the President of Sordland to the stage.”
“I want to acknowledge the brilliant mind behind this project, the esteemed Minister of Economy and Tax, Symon Holl. Please come over here.”
entradas.menu: “I want to acknowledge the brilliant mind behind this project, the esteemed Minister of Economy and Tax, Symon Holl. Please come over here.”

entradas.text: “Nothing like a cheerful crowd. Looking forward to it.”
entradas.menu: “Nothing like a cheerful crowd. Looking forward to it.”

entradas.text: The chanting and excitement from the crowd intensified. A large group began singing the national anthem.
“Citizens! Welcome to the opening ceremony of the L-1 High-speed railway!”
entradas.menu: “Citizens! Welcome to the opening ceremony of the L-1 High-speed railway!”

entradas.text: “Holsordians! Welcome to the opening ceremony of the L-1 High-speed railway.”
entradas.menu: “Holsordians! Welcome to the opening ceremony of the L-1 High-speed railway.”

entradas.text: “None of this would be possible without the sound advice of my cabinet member Gus Manger. Please come over here.”
entradas.menu: “None of this would be possible without the sound advice of my cabinet member Gus Manger. Please come over here.”

entradas.text: “Like the good old campaign days.”
entradas.menu: “Like the good old campaign days.”

entradas.text: “We will show our best face tomorrow. Meanwhile, I'll make sure that our message about improving the countryside gets across.”
The chanting from the crowd continued. Some were yelling the motto of Holsord: High above all.
“At the beginning of this journey, we promised jobs and opportunity. We kept our promise.”
entradas.menu: “At the beginning of this journey, we promised jobs and opportunity. We kept our promise.”

entradas.text: “Our intention with the L-1 Railway was to allow citizens to easily commute between the major cities of Holsord and Lachaven.”
entradas.menu: “Our intention with the L-1 Railway was to allow citizens to easily commute between the major cities of Holsord and Lachaven.”

entradas.text: “Trust me, our work is far from over. This project is only the beginning.”
entradas.menu: “Trust me, our work is far from over. This project is only the beginning.”

entradas.text: “Things were certainly easier back then.”
“We had our disagreements, but the important thing was the outcome. The Sordish people have been waiting a long time for this.”
“Agreed. Every single press outlet has of course been notified and they will be there.”
“I think all of us are.”
“Symon, you deserve the credit. After all, it was you who came up with the project.”
entradas.menu: “Symon, you deserve the credit. After all, it was you who came up with the project.”

entradas.text: “Thank you for your kind words. It truly means a good deal.”
entradas.menu: “Thank you for your kind words. It truly means a good deal.”

entradas.text: “Beginning with the President who put his trust in me, I want to thank all who were involved in L-1.”
“On another note. It goes without mentioning that this was a team effort.”
Symon went on to explain how this railway was a crucial stepping stone on the way to a full Sordish economic recovery.
Gus continued to explain the many benefits the upgraded railway would bring to the areas along its path.
The crowd began cheering my name.
It was a sunny day in our usually cloudy capital city.
The crowd looked quite large. I spotted many party members.
“I welcome you Holsordians today as a proud servant of this country.”
“Our aim with this project wasobvious: to improve the speed and efficiency of transportation.”
“Holsord! It is great to be here in this beautiful capital that does so much good for this country.”
Symon handed me an oversized pair of scissors.
“The journey to Lachaven should take about four hours. The rest of us will be on the train as well."
“I have a plan on how to do that.”
“If the President accepts, driving the first high-speed train to Lachaven would be great for our image nationwide.”
Lucian stood up.
“Well done, everyone.”
“To many more projects like this.”
“Good work.”
entradas.menu: “Good work.”

entradas.text: “We couldn't have done this without our excellent team.”
entradas.menu: “We couldn't have done this without our excellent team.”

entradas.text: I silently nodded.
entradas.menu: Nod.

entradas.text: “Indeed.”
“Let's move on to our plans for the opening tomorrow.”
“What are your thoughts?”
“I think so too. Mr. President?”
“I guess we can't avoid that.”
entradas.menu: “I guess we can't avoid that.”

entradas.text: “Thank you.”
entradas.menu: “Thank you.”

entradas.text: “Once again, good work everyone.”
entradas.menu: “Once again, good work everyone.”

entradas.text: Lucian took Gus' place after he was done with his speech.
Lucian took Symon's place after he was done with his speech.
“Citizens of Holsord! There you have it!”
“As promised, Anton Rayne, the 4th President of Sordland, has delivered!”
“My fellow Holsordians! I welcome you today to the opening ceremony of our L-1 High-speed railway.”
entradas.menu: “My fellow Holsordians! I welcome you today to our opening ceremony of the L-1 High-speed railway.”

entradas.text: Though the construction delay had taken its toll on our morale, this was still a proud moment for all of us.
“First of all...”
“This day might have arrived later than expected, but it doesn't change the fact that we are here now.”
“This is still a big success. Congratulations, everyone.”
